avis.titre: NO SMELL OR ODOR, FEELS GREAT
avis.texte: It is not greasy. Leaves no film ir coating on skin. Not heavy on skin. It is very lite. I put on a good coat on my skin, rub on it to coat but not leave thick. It soaks in almost immediately. You don't feel it all. It makes your skin moisturized and feeling great. But most important it Has NO SMELL OF ANY KIND OR ODOR OR FRAGRANCE OR MASKING FRAGRANCE!! MY skin is very thin because of age and medications. A lot of lotions have no smell in bottles until I put on my skin, then I smell them Thus product never smells. This size last a long time. My skin is so thin and gets so dry it burns to touch or the shower spray hitting my skin. This lotion fixes that problem. It is a great product. It goes on very well and spreads well. It's not to runny or thick to apply.I am not active and need to moisturize my skin. My skn has ripped in past when when I fell and was picked up, and when I slipped out of the arms of someone picking me up it's so thin and was dry. This lotion really helps. Feels great on skin

avis.titre: Lotion that sinks in and works!
avis.texte: I got this yesterday and can already leave a glowing review Which is not a shock - vanicream is the best. Literally I use their face moisturizer and face cleanser and they work incredibly well for very fair sensitive skin prone to rosacea and acne They keep my skin clear and not dried or irritated. I have tried everything. As far as this lotion goes - it is a creamy consistency but absorbs so well. Your skin is not left sticky or tacky like many others. I have a Eucerin urea body lotion that leaves me feeling like I am covered in sweat and to be fair my skin would still be rough in spots. So it wasn’t worth it If you’re on the fence with this don’t be - vanicream is hands down one of the best companies for products that work well for sensitive skin and those who don’t respond well to fragrance. I’m happy I tried this so I can stop searching for a lotion that does exactly what I wanted which is meaning skin soft and hydrated but not feeling like you put anything on your skin. Not to mention their products are affordable and a little goes a long way. Buy it!

avis.titre: Wonderful lotion for the sensitive skin folks.
avis.texte: This has been a wonderful choice. I developed a rash on my face and spots on my head that were red and itchy after accidentally eating something with peanuts and having a reaction. I saw the dermatologist who gave me a steroid type med but you have to take a break when using it. She suggested this during the break. I also had an infected tooth that needed a root canal and they gave me meds for it. A short while after starting it the rash went away but came back when done. I bought this product and it has totally helped. The dr was going to prescribe a $1600 medication that insurance doesn’t cover but she gave a sample and it burned. Needless to say I never got it. This lotion has helped my face, scalp and my hands. It doesn’t burn and it doesn’t have the normal lotion aspect of stopping your skin from breathing. lol. My words. If you have sensitive skin, don’t like fragrances, need moisturizer without the thick heavy feeling, or have some odd issue like me, I definitely suggest this. Feel better.
Love the Vanicream lotion. I use it on my face and it feels very light and non greasy. Makes my skin feel so smooth. Calms my eczema itching. Very good product. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Excellent skin lotion without unnecessary ingredients!
avis.texte: I purchased this Vanicream moisturizing lotion after a recommendation by my dermatologist. I do have drawers full of skin products that I cannot use due to my extremely sensitive skin. I have very dry skin and psoriasis as well. I love this lotion because it absorbs well without feeling greasy. A little bit goes a long way and the pump is perfect for dispensing without a mess. There are only a few ingredients and it is fragrance free and does not contain all of the added fillers, that many other brands have. I also use some of their other products, but this lotion is my favorite. It is most definitely worth the price for a large bottle. I have purchased it several times and it always has consistent quality. I highly recommend this lotion.
Best lotion out there, it doesn’t leave you feeling greasy or oily, my daughter deals with skin issues and this is one that doesn’t burn when applied and gives moisture and lasts threw out the day

I have super sensitive skin and have been getting bit by so many bugs. I needed something that is fragrance free and still moisturizing and safe to use. This product is perfect for all of the above. It’s very light and creamy. Easy to rub in and absorbs quickly. Unfortunately received broken. It was just thrown in a box with no protective wrapping, so I may try to find this in stores next time.

avis.titre: Absorbs easily and not too heavy
avis.texte: A nice replacement for a previous brand that wasn’t too heavy, not scented and easily absorbed into my hands for repeated daily use. This fit the bill perfectly. Husband approved too.

I was hesitant to buy this as I heard a lot of bad things about petrolatum product. To my surprise, it's very good. Calms my red, flaking skin due to seborrheic dermatitis and psoriasis. It's cheap too.

avis.titre: For Sensitive People with Severe Allergies
avis.texte: The best lotion for sensitive skin or for those that have severe eczema & skin allergies.

avis.titre: Excellent all over moisturizer for very sensitive skin .
avis.texte: I have very sensitive , dry skin and this moisturizer has been wonderful , my skin feels smooth and soft and no allergic reactions . It goes on easy and smooth , non greasy and only needs one all over application in the morning , lasts all day . Highly recommend .

First and foremost, when choosing a cream, I looked at the ingredients to make sure it didn’t contain any petroleum-derived ingredients. Of course, I also wanted it to be reasonably priced. This product met both of my criteria. It is marketed as a lotion, but I would describe it as a proper body cream to apply after a shower. It doesn’t absorb particularly quickly or easily, but it does eventually sink in and doesn’t leave a film on the skin. The moisturizing effect isn’t the strongest, but overall, it does a decent job and provides at least half of the level of hydration I would ideally expect from a body cream.

My friend with extremely sensitive skin used this and was the only thing she could use. That got me hooked. It does a great job of moisturizing all skin types and is fragrance free. If I want some scent, I mix it with a scented lotion. The consistency isn’t too thick, isn’t greasy at all, applies easy and absorbs quick. Very simple ingredients and a great value for the money. Plus, I love the pump dispenser!

Very light, smooth application that absorbs quickly. Zero smell, and not sticky or greasy. Keeps skin soft and hydrated while keeping my skin irritation free! Minimal ingredients and cleaner than most. Daily applications and so far it’s lasted me about two months. Not out yet and I use it all day for my hands as well. Great price for the amount you get.

avis.titre: Works for me, might work for you too!
avis.texte: I have tried many, many lotions. I have tried moisturizers from brands like CeraVe, Aveeno, Cetaphil, Gold Bond, BioDerma, La Roche-Posay, Eucerin Lubriderm Beauty without Cruelty, Ceramedx, Dove, Shea Moisture, illiyoon, Philosophy, Garnier, etc. So when I tell you I've tried a good portion, I really mean it. However, after trying a mix of very moisturizers, I find myself coming back to this one time and time again. I have tried the cream version of this product and it works well but obviously feels greasier and thicker that this one. I have dry skin with some areas that peel and bleed from the lack of moisture sometimes and even for my skin, it felt a little too thick. This lotion offers that hydrated feel without the clammy, almost sweat-like feel that thicker creams give. Unlike those, this feels soft and is a great fit when using prescribed products or more unforgiving ingredients like benzoyl peroxide or salicylic acid. There is no overpowering and nauseating aroma and probably is the least "lotiony smelling" product I have tried. It might not be for everyone but at this price, for those considering a good holy grail moisturizer that isn't the cost of your entire monthly skincare budget, it might be worth a try.

Excellent skin moisturizing, doesn’t leave a greasy residue and no fragrance. This is my second purchase and I will buy more. They need to figure a better way to ship this product. This bottle arrived with a broken application nozzle. At least I can refill the existing bottle I still have.

I don’t know why I keep trying other moisturizers- I always keep going back to this one. A friend recommended this to me years ago, and since then it has always been my “fallback “ moisturizer when I try a new one and it goes awry. My most recent attempt was the moisturizer from The Ordinary which was okay, but I ultimately switched back to Vanicream. It is light but effective and you get a lot for the price. I have extremely sensitive, acne prone skin, and this does the job with no irritation. I do sometimes have to add another layer if my skin is feeling super dry or if I want that “night cream” feeling before bed but, after many trials and tribulations, I end up always coming back.

Recommended by my dermatologist a few years ago and I have never used another product to keep my skin beautiful and young, especially my face. For many years I tried other very expensive products for dry skin and nothing worked until I started using this product which by the way is quite cheap and does the job it is intended to do. So if you are one of those people like me with dry skin, this is your remedy and I recommend it without a doubt. Believe me, you will never use anything else to keep your skin young and "Believe me, you will never use anything else to keep your skin young and CHEMICAL-FREE."

Great price for this. It’s about $3.50 cheaper than Walmart and same price as Target. But this gets delivered to your door! This is a must have for sensitive skin. I like the LITE version better than regular as the regular is too thick and is hard to rub in. This is the perfect consistency and doesn’t feel greasy. In the photos, the LITE is on the left, regular on the right The 2nd photo shows after rubbing in for 10 strokes. You can see the regular is still very visible and the LITE is almost soaked in.
I bought this because it is said to be safe during pregnancy. I found it has a strange smell comparing to Cerave moisturizer. I guess it is fine. I just don’t like that strange smell.

I’m allergic to almost every lotion I’ve tried. I’ve finally found one I can use! Just started using it, but it seems like it will work well. I was hesitant to buy it after seeing other people’s packaging issues, but mine was fine. It had a plastic piece to prevent the pump from accidentally dispensing it on transport.

I love this skin priduct. It leaves my skin feeling fresh, clean and breezy. The price is reasonable, but the skin cream should be a little less, though. Overall, I'm satisfied with this product, its skin care combination that my sensitive skin will thank me later!

My baby was struggling with mildly dry skin. At her 4 month wellness check we brought this up to her pediatrician. She recommended vanicream for use on her face, ears, and scalp. After 4 uses my babies skin went from kind of dry to bright red, hot to the touch, peeling, and blistering. The only change was the use of vanicream. We use tide free and clear laundry detergent and the same mild baby soap since she was born. I just wanted to get this out there and say if you think it's the vanicream, it is!

avis.titre: Product is great, packaging not so much
avis.texte: Because the items were relatively loosely packed, one of the dispensers was broke of at the top of the bottle...
Size is pretty good. It doesn't have any scent. Will be trying it in the next days.
The product come without pump, it spilled all over the box and the rest of the products that came with it.

I ordered this for my daughter who has eczema and it’s doing amazing things.. so I ordered another for my grandmother, just to get these ridiculous elves instead. 🤦🏾‍♀️ I’m one mad customer. I recommend the product, but this is ridiculous.

I really wanted to like this product. I have very sensitive skin that gets irritated by even the most basic product and i heard a lot of good things about this moisturizer. It doesn’t irritate me at all and is fragrance free, which is great. However, it dries out my skin. Instead of feeling moisturized, it gets tight and flaky. I like the vanicream cleanser, but this moisturizer is a no from me

I am not happy with the product. The pump was broken and there was no trace of the broken piece in the box, meaning, it was intentionally sent. Now, i cannot use the lotion properly since the pump is broken.

The pump was broken on arrival, in spite of the guard being intact. There was lotion on other items in the box. Luckily, I had an almost used bottle so I swapped the pumps. Avoid ordering on subscribe and save, or with other heavy items, as it doesn’t appear they give the bottle any added protection.
Product is great for my skin, but product Pump came broken and had lost some lotion while in transit. Guess it’s “pouring lotion in hand” time for now.

avis.titre: Remarkably Light & Non-Oily; No More Rashes
avis.texte: After a lifetime of brutal rashes -- often in intimate places -- my dermatologist diagnosed me with contact dermatitis: Out with skin care products with "fragrance" and/or “parfum,” and in with the full Vanicream line, including this wonderfully light Moisturizing Lotion. It’s been life-changing. It pumps out fairly thin in both appearance and feel, and attractively so. No hint of scent, no sense of oil or grease, yet somehow, it truly does hydrate and moisturize. Most critically, no more rashes. I now also use the shampoo, conditioner, antiperspirant, and cleansing bar, and feel no less clean and presentable. My only cheats are ultra-rare uses of a scented deodorant when my confidence requires it; my sensitive skin forgives those rare uses and avoids punishing me with breakouts. For those with skin ailments -- eczema and psoriasis included -- eliminating scents and additives can be game-changing, and this lite lotion does its part at a great low-cost value. - (Was this "Helpful"? Cheers!)
The pump was broken as shown in the video when I opened the box.
It's not very moisturizing and it liquidy vs the ones I usually buy in store which is very thick and a little bit goes a long way.

I like how fast shipping was. However, I am highly frustrated that this product is not sealed. It is a major concern as I don’t know what could have been put in these bottles or how long they have been sitting on a shelf.
No, thanks I am not gonna use a product that would affect my health
The pump was broken when received, making the lotion unusable.
Product arrived - all three bottles, with the cream spilled outside the bottle and all over the package. I don' t know if the bottles were defective, but it was a mess.
Horrible product came with no top spilling all over the box and half empty.
Very disappointed. I love the products but I can't trust that they will be delivered without being damaged. I lost half of the bottle of lotion before I even got to use it.
I purchased this for my dry skin after applying it still feels dry when using need something thicker it’s not bad but doesn’t work for my skin

❤️this lotion definitely does the trick! 👉 I wash my hands about 5 times an hour, mostly due to cleaning up after my gramps and kitten, so they are painfully dry! 👉As you can see in the pic I posted, my knuckles take a beating. They are cracked and because my hands are so dry, it’s easier for my kittens claws to do damage. 👉It doesn’t leave a greasy or sticky residue. 👉It also gets absorbed quickly, but I don’t have to reapply more 10 seconds after because it’s a great moisturizer (some lotions seem to absorb well but my hands still feel dry) 👉I took this pic when my hands were the driest, then added the lotion so you can get a good idea of the before and after to see how well it works.... 👉I know my knuckles look redder after the lotion is applied, but the lotion doesn’t burn and the red is temporary. You can see how much smoother my skin is! 👉PLEASE upvote my review if you found it helpful! Thanks😁

My allergy doctor recommended this. It is effective and goes on without leaving stickiness or oiliness. I can use my hands without leaving smudges on things. I use it on my face and body daily. I did have a problem with the packaging/ delivery. It was boxed missing the top dispenser. Its been broken off but the broken off part was not in the box. Very odd. Since this packaging problem has nothing to do with the product review, I still give it a 5 star rating. I am including photos of what was in the box. I only removed the packing slip. The third photo is my old bottle so you can see what is missing. Follow up: I found where to give feedback on broken bottle. A new bottle was sent to me immediately!....maybe the next day. Thank you Amazon.

avis.titre: Lighter weight than their moisturizing cream
avis.texte: I love vanicream products and have used their moisturizing cream forever. However, that product is very thick, which can sometimes be inconvenient in the humid summertime. This lotion is very lightweight, unscented, and perfect for sensitive skin. It is dry within 10-20 minutes, so I can put on clothes pretty soon after my shower! Will continue to purchase.

I'm baffled. This scored 10/100 on Yuka. That's terrible. It contains chemicals such as BHT. Just a quick research and there are studies that says... "These chemicals are linked to several health concerns including endocrine disruption and organ-system toxicity." That's just scratching the surface. What's even more disappointing is that I actually love their facial moisturizer, which scored 100/100. Would not have bought it if the ingredients were clearly stated in the pictures, which I tried reading, but they cleverly made it blurry by posting the worst quality photo ever in existence. But I figured "hey, they made a great product before, no way this will bad". WRONG. Now I go back to check the item description and you have to scroll down until you find the ingredients, touche. I give them an extra star for fooling me. The power of laziness to not scroll down was my downfall. One of the studies of BHT suggests that "it may also have effects on the s*x hormones and may affect fertility and development". Bro, I want my future copy to be smart and handsome. Sabotage!

The contents look satisfactory. However, because the top is broken, the pump is not usable and you have to unscrew it to use the lotion. Additional hassle is that you have to apply for a refund for this broken product.
